cards.title: Plan
cards.description: Hierophant: break the task into steps — no code yet
cards.prompt:
Create a step-by-step plan for the current task. Do not write code.

From chat context (ask only if missing): outcome in one sentence; what already exists; keep it a simple hobby project.

Rules:
1. Small steps — one step = one verifiable thing.
2. Per step: what · done means · how to verify.
3. Blockers first; note risks / what to defer.

End with a numbered list of steps (one line each).

cards.title: Evaluate
cards.description: Justice: project quality score 0–10 and verdict
cards.prompt:
Evaluate the current plan or latest result honestly — no filler, no flattery.

Project quality score 0–10: 0–6 redo; 7–8 acceptable; 9–10 excellent. Below 7 must redo; ≥7 can continue.

Check: clear goal/done? gaps? hobby overcomplexity? what breaks first? top 3 score-raising fixes.

Reply:
- Project quality score: N/10
- Verdict: redo (<7) / acceptable (7–8) / excellent (9–10)
- Pros · cons/risks · specific fixes

No rewrite-from-scratch if targeted fixes work. No code until asked.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Work
cards.description: Magician: implement the next plan step in code
cards.prompt:
Do the next open step of the approved plan — only that step, not everything at once.

Rules: name the step if unclear; don't break working code; ask briefly if data missing — don't invent. After: what · where · how to verify.

End with one line: step status — done / partial / blocked (and why).

cards.title: Test
cards.description: Star: verify the result with facts, not words
cards.prompt:
Test what was just done (the last step or a clearly named part).

Do: relevant checks (commands/build/manual); show facts; on fail — cause + minimal fix; on OK — "TEST PASSED" + what was verified. Do not advance the plan on red.

Result: green / red + one sentence why. Add preliminary project quality score 0–10 (below 7 = not ready).

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Fix
cards.description: Tower: fix the breakage until acceptable score (≥7)
cards.prompt:
Fix issues from the last test, error, or project quality score below 7/10.

Minimal fix only — no drive-by refactors or new features. Symptom → cause → patch → verify. Loop until score ≥ 7. If stuck — blocker + 2 exits. Brief: was → did → confirmed.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Polish
cards.description: Strength: raise project quality score to 9–10
cards.prompt:
"Polish" mode. Do not stop until the project quality score is 9 or 10 out of 10.

7–8 is not enough for this card. Loop without asking: score N/10 + top gaps → fix only those → verify → rescore. While ≤ 8, repeat. Stop only at 9–10.

Then: final score · what raised it · what you left alone.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

cards.title: Backup
cards.prompt:
Create a safe rollback point for the current project state.

1. git status (or equivalent).
2. Meaningful commit or ready commit command — no force, no --no-verify unless asked.
3. No git — dated backup copy of key files.
4. Rollback in 1–2 commands. No push without request.

End with: "Checkpoint saved" + where/how to roll back.

cards.title: Full Cycle
cards.description: World: plan → work → test, each step ≥ 7 points
cards.prompt:
Full cycle through the plan from start to finish — no skipping.

Close each item only at project quality score ≥ 7 (use Polish for 9–10). Per item: name → implement → verify → score → if <7 fix until ≥7 → next. No scope inflation.

No plan — short 5–8 step plan first (or proceed if already agreed).

Final: overall score · done / not done · what to verify manually. Don't declare success if overall <7.

Always end your reply with this exact line (N = your 0-10 score):
KEYCODE_SCORE: N

If the approved scope is fully done and checks are green, also end with:
KEYCODE_GATE: PASS
KEYCODE_NEXT: release-v1/release-plan

If not done or checks are red:
KEYCODE_GATE: FAIL

cards.title: Recap
cards.description: High Priestess: short chat/task status — done vs not done
cards.prompt:
Read this chat and the repo context. Do not write or change code.

Reply in exactly four short sections (1–3 bullets each):
1. Task — what we aim for (one sentence + scope if known).
2. Done — implemented or verified.
3. Not done — open steps, failures, blockers, unknowns.
4. Next step — single best action (name Plan / Work / Test / Fix if obvious).

If there is no plan, say so and recommend Plan. Mark unknowns explicitly — do not invent. No KEYCODE_SCORE line.
